thread:
Priya (product): Quick sync — Elastic Lanes launch: three cross-team blockers. Need a hard gating checklist so we can sequence work. Runtime batching validation, infra autoscaler quota, and KMS/HSM signoff. Who wants to take ownership of the checklist?
Sam (eng-runtime): Sam — runtime batching PR is functionally ready but it still needs a quantization artifact pinned and a KV cache warmup plan. Also want a target p99 number to aim for.
Akemi (eng-infra): Infra — autoscaler shim is in staging but we need a canary policy + finance quota to guarantee capacity. Also need to lock the instance type for predictable perf.
Jordan (security): Security — KMS integration looks fine for hosted, but on-prem customers require HSM procurement and install. We also need a key rotation policy and proof-of-audit before launch.
Maya (eng-platform): Platform — per-tenant routing & deploy scripts are ready. Main gap: explicit rollback criteria and automated canary gating. Need an SLO to gate rollout (tail latency).
Priya (product): Proposed gating checklist: 1) Runtime: continuous batching validated under representative traffic with p99 <= 350ms, 2) Infra: autoscaler sustains 2x baseline for 30m, 3) Security: KMS + audit logs + rotation policy, 4) Platform: automated canary + rollback. Agree?
Sam (eng-runtime): :thumbsup: Add a load-profile test that simulates 10% peak with synthetic requests. Also we should pin the model quantization artifact versions in the runtime PR.
Akemi (eng-infra): We can guarantee 2x in staging but finance must approve committed slots for production to meet the SLA. @Priya can you surface the budget ask? For gating, can we accept 'autoscaler baked in staging + quota request submitted'?
Priya (product): Yes — that would unblock dev work. I'll present the budget ask at exec sync. For the formal gate, subscribe to the condition 'quota request submitted and tracked' if procurement is pending.
Jordan (security): For hosted customers that works. On-prem remains blocked until HSM is installed — add "on-prem launch deferred until HSM installed" to the public doc.
Maya (eng-platform): Rollback criteria proposal: automatic rollback if error rate increases by >2% or p99 latency exceeds SLO for 5 continuous minutes. Need an ops runbook entry and playbook snippets.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll add a short checklist in GH and a KV warmup script. PR link: http://git.internal/ri/elastic-lanes/runtime-batching (will push updates).
Priya (product): Owners: Runtime=Sam, Infra=Akemi, Security=Jordan, Platform=Maya. I'll take stakeholder comms + budget owner. Action items due EOD Wed. Flag now if you can't meet that.
Akemi (eng-infra): Accepted. Quota request submitted today. HSM hardware ETA 6-8 weeks for on-prem customers.
Jordan (security): Will draft key rotation policy + audit checklist by Thu and share with Priya for inclusion.
Maya (eng-platform): Will finish canary config + runbook and post updates by Wed EOD.
Priya (product): Perfect — I'll synthesize into a one-pager and drop in #product later today. Thanks all! :rocket:
deploy-bot: New canary build deployed to staging (build 2026.3.22.11). Checkmarks: runtime-batching=true, autoscaler=staging, kv-warmup=incubating."
